newsitem.title: USA: Teleport to buy rest of Biztel.
newsitem.headline: Teleport to buy rest of Biztel.

text.p: Teleport Communications Group Inc said on Tuesday it has agreed to acquire the remaining 50.1 percent interest in BizTel Communications Inc that it does not already own for 1.667 million Teleport Class A common shares.
BizTel Communications is the holding company for BizTel Inc, which provides high quality broadband 38 GHz wireless services in 48 states, Teleport said.

Teleport, which alreadys owns 49.9 percent of Biztel, said the agreement is subject to both Hart-Scott-Rodino and FCC approvals, becomes effective after July 15, 1997 when it can exercise the option .

Under currently held FCC licenses, BizTel operates 38 GHz facilities in more than 150 of the top markets in the country and Teleport already resells BizTel services in several markets, the company said.
As of the end of 1996, Teleport had approximately 160 million shares outstanding.
